title: calandrinia gaudichaudii
intro: Calandrinia gaudichaudii, commonly known as Red Maire or Patagua, is a plant species native to the Andean region, belonging to the Montiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its efficacy in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Calandrinia gaudichaudii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and anticancer activities.
